detection.reason: smallest per-blob size that returns the correct count and stays correct at every larger size

method.alpha_rule: alpha = 0.01 when n >= 300, 0.05 when n >= 60, 0.10 when n >= 30 (per calibration/derive.ALPHA_LADDER)
method.noise_floor: no-op controls: blob_object (n=1 true component) and multipart_object (n=3 true components) under identity, rescale_roundtrip@{0.9,0.75}, jpeg_reencode@{95,85}, gaussian_blur@{0.5,1.0}, add_noise@{sigma=2,4}. Metric: largest spurious blob frame-fraction, threshold = bootstrap CI upper bound of Q(1-alpha).
method.real_change: independent PIL.ImageDraw corpus: rounded rectangles at counts {1..6} and sides {6,8,12,16,24,32,48} pixels on PREVIEW_BG, laid non-overlapping so the count is a hand-countable literal integer. Detection limit = smallest per-blob side that yields the correct count at every larger size.

verdict.reason: noise floor is within one decade of the smallest reliably-detected blob; demote per docs/phase3-handoff.md section 5
verdict.ship_criterion: signal_to_floor_ratio >= 10 (one decade separation between noise floor and useful signal)
